steps.content: The front of the pickup truck has been crushed and deformed. The poor driver inside is probably dead.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...There are only the two of us left.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: There are too many of them. Chief, stay behind me.

steps.speaker: Reckless Legionnaire
steps.content: You're still able to fight? Tough bones you've got! Nothing less expected from a Sinner!

steps.speaker: Reckless Legionnaire
steps.content: Wanna join the Legion? Our boss will like you. You'll have much more freedom than being a running dog for the Bureau.

steps.speaker: Reckless Legionnaire
steps.content: Tsk. Then work hard on your own.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: On your own, my ***! I'm still alive!
Hella wriggles out from under the burning pickup truck. Unfortunately, she is stuck on the opposite side of the vehicle.

options: Are you injured? Can you come over here?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content:
Worry about yourself.
... I'll crawl over to join you guys soon.
Glancing at the burning driver's seat, she can probably imagine the driver's tragic fate and suddenly gets angry.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ****, what do they have against us that they have to kill every one of us!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I'm pissed! Let them all come at me! I'll give each of their heads a hundred blows!
